verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee is a web-scraping API service, not an agent or assistant that consumes external tools, so acting as an MCP client is a category error for this product type. The evidence shows only an official MCP server (mcp.scrapingbee.com), which is the server role. Server-side evidence does not make the client axis applicable, and nothing shows the product connecting to third-party MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
